findings_and_questions.classification: new conditional 95e source-level admission/operation candidate; supported in-product producer and global alias remain open
findings_and_questions.mechanism: GarmentSelection and MailWeave have public mutable fields. Inventory::get_mut returns mutable InventoryItem, whose Article can contain a draped selection; validation is a separate operation and add itself does not validate. After an already generated chainmail DrapeMesh exists, a caller can change its stored weave without revalidating it. When the offline-creator scheduled refresh_mail sees a changed weave and finds that mesh and chainmail selection, it calls MailMaterials::material. A previously unseen invalid weave reaches MailMaps::new, whose first step is weave.validate(), and the caller expects success. For example, after a valid mesh exists, an outer diameter 0.003m paired with wire diameter 0.0011m violates the max-wire relation; this is a symbolic source comparison, not executed. That conditional path yields an Err at validate and a panic at the expect if the refresh system runs.
findings_and_questions.conditions_and_limits: Requires a valid previously displayed mesh, a later invalid programmatic mutation or other unproved bad producer, a changed weave, relevant scheduled system, and a cache miss. Normal user sliders/load flows may preserve valid parameters; no source-backed claim that they make this invalid value, no actual runtime/UI execution, no observed crash, no feature activation beyond manifest/build-boundary declarations. Serde and public fields alone are not proof of acceptance into a normal workflow.
findings_and_questions.historical_relationship: 774 rig ADDITIONAL-036 and 059 L11-425 already note public raw selection/mail fields and explicit garment validation; 059 PL13-111 documents that the selected drape path validates first. This finding concerns a later public mutable retained state and live preview refresh, not proof that the prior validated drape gate fails. Exact global alias and policy remain central; q2478 concerns a different coif typed-error conversion.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Trace all actual mutable producers and preview/wardrobe pathways; if invalid mutations are supported, keep the weave checked across changes or validate/fallibly report at refresh while preserving appearance-only edits and avoiding unnecessary re-draping. No implementation or validation performed.

thirteen_lenses.producer-propagation: Garment controls, inventory mutable producer, drape admission and preview material paths traced only in recorded windows; all actual mutation/data producers and feature paths remain open.
thirteen_lenses.existing-type-owners: Construction, FabricPreset, ClothLayer, UnderlayerKind, Millimeters and Permille carry distinct semantics; raw material state is separately mutable and may cross the selected preview boundary.
thirteen_lenses.admission-contracts: Public Serde and fields allow raw DTOs; selected drape, wardrobe and CutPlan call validation, whereas public mutation and regions are distinct paths. Conditional preview expectation requires later invalid mutable input.
thirteen_lenses.invariant-operations: Coif validate maps a typed source error to text; mail refresh expects the validating PNG generator to succeed. These are different operations and related policies.
thirteen_lenses.aggregate-states: Fabric versus construction is an explicitly unresolved coif policy; finite ordered SurfaceBox endpoints are checked at UnderlayerDesign validation, not automatically by regions.
thirteen_lenses.type-ownership: Garment/fabric semantics, weave parameters, UnderlayerDesign and native material/geometry consumers remain separate authorities; UI vs validated admission is an owner question.
thirteen_lenses.redundant-authority: Form and mail classification are derived from construction/fabric; no independent stored duplicate proved. A cached preview may outlive the last valid selection; actual mutation policy is open.
thirteen_lenses.behavior-preservation: Assigned historical/current sources match byte-for-byte but snapshots and surrounding consumers differ. Zero stage steps, fitted mode, empty cuts and chainmail layer override are documented legitimate modes.
thirteen_lenses.enum-shapes: Enums own closed fabric, construction, cloth layer and underlayer kinds. No type rewrite or forced cross-variant restrictions justified without coif policy.
thirteen_lenses.derivability: Derived Serde is raw structural decoding, not semantic acceptance. Existing explicit validation and selective simulation identity have distinct purposes.
thirteen_lenses.type-granularity: Permille values above 1000 are explicitly supported for some lengths; reference-space coordinates and mesh resolution carry distinct units; no blanket interval or generic numeric type is justified.
thirteen_lenses.magic-strings: Coif DesignError Debug formatting and distinct underlayer reason strings have earlier 059 records; actual consumer policy and exact aliases are still open.
thirteen_lenses.magic-numbers: Named resolution, clearance, thickness, kind lengths, stage bounds, fabric parameters and ring/wire ratios are visible; policy and extreme input implications are not proven merely by literals.
